title: Accuracy vs Precision vs Recall vs F1: Evaluation Metrics Explained
description:
With a rare class, accuracy can be misleading. Precision, recall and F1 show what a classifier actually gets right.

In this short:
• 100 patients, only 10 of them sick
• A model that calls everyone healthy is 90% accurate and catches no one
• A real model's confusion matrix: 8 caught, 2 missed, 6 false alarms, 84 correctly cleared
• Precision: 8 of the 14 flagged are truly sick, 57%
• Recall: it finds 8 of the 10 sick, 80%
• Moving the threshold trades one for the other; F1 balances both (0.67)
